Totally get it—shopping on the app can feel like standing in front of an overstuffed closet! Here’s how to narrow things down:

Stick to our vibe: We focus on high-end contemporary, luxury, vintage and boutique pieces, not fast fashion.
Check lenders: Look at response rate, acceptance rate and reviews, plus Active/Muse/Pro badges for extra trust.
Use reviews as a guide: Items with more renter reviews are usually a safer bet, especially for higher-value categories.
Message the lender: Ask about sizing, fit, condition and availability directly via the envelope icon on the listing.
Trust good profiles: Clear photos, a friendly bio and transparent details usually mean a more reliable experience.

So, to choose what’s right for you, focus on trusted lenders, detailed listings and message owners with any sizing or style questions before you commit.

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Totally get wanting to keep costs sensible – there are a few handy ways to do that with us:
Use suggested pricing: As a lender, follow our optimal pricing tips and compare with similar listings to stay reasonable.
Go for weekly/monthly rates: These are discounted vs daily, great for holidays or longer events.
First-time renter? You get 15% off your first rental (max £15) on orders over £20, automatically at checkout.
Referral credit: Share your referral link – you and your friend each get £10 credit on £20+ rentals or resale purchases once they complete their first order.
Use your lending earnings: If you lend items out, you can pay for future rentals directly from your in-app balance instead of new cash.
So your best budget-friendly options are: book longer periods for built-in discounts, stack your first-rental offer or referral credit where eligible, and recycle your lending earnings to fund new rentals.
